stories.name: Alert Dialog
stories.expectation: Preserve this native static source depiction; event, value and focus contracts remain unresolved.

contractProtocol: SCXML consumes source-normalized interaction/callback transactions. eventDetails is the source callback object. onOpenChange/onValueChange sends project those observed callbacks, never dispatch a second DOM event. _effect.* entries are internal source focus/application effects, not public component events. Controlled SET_OPEN/SET_VALUE synchronizes props without fabricating a callback.

contractCases.expected: The source callback and documented state policy apply; controlled props remain authoritative.
The proposed callback can be observed while the public state remains unchanged.

The alert dialog is modal. This reference chooses Cancel as initialFocus using the actual Popup prop. Tab remains inside; Escape/Cancel dismiss without confirming and return focus. Outside press is ignored by the primitive.
